facts.text: Tarpey Village’s quiet streets echo a sense of history, with ranch‑style homes that give the town a timeless, classic Californian charm.
At just 351 feet above sea level, Tarpey Village sits comfortably in the foothills of California’s Central Valley.
The town’s schools—Tarpey Elementary, Alta Sierra Intermediate, and Buchanan High—serve as community hubs for families and students alike.
Nature lovers find delight in Tarpey’s parks, where lush greenery and peaceful walking trails invite residents to explore the outdoors.
Every doorstep in Tarpey feels like a homecoming, with neighbors quickly turning from strangers into friends during local festivals and farmers markets.
Tarpey embraces diversity, culture, and opportunity, positioning itself as more than a place to live—it’s a place to belong.
